source.title: [re:DEFINICIJA] Daniel Wurzberg: U brak se ulaže svaki dan (ep. 1)

summary.title_hr: [re:DEFINICIJA] Daniel Wurzberg: U brak se ulaže svaki dan (ep. 1)
summary.abstract_hr: U prvoj epizodi podcasta Redefinicija portala Muževni budite voditelj Kruno razgovara s Danielom Wurzbergom, ocem četvero djece i dugogodišnjim djelatnikom Udruge Fokus, koji sa suprugom Kate radi s bračnim i zaručničkim parovima. Razgovor obuhvaća stigmu oko bračnog savjetovanja, važnost predbračne pripreme, komunikaciju kao najčešći uzrok sukoba, spolnost u braku, pornografiju i financije. Gost ističe da je brak potrebno svakodnevno njegovati, poput održavanja automobila, te da je većina problema zapravo nedostatak vještina komunikacije i rješavanja sukoba, koje se mogu naučiti. Predstavlja i knjigu "Naše nedovršene priče" te program za muškarce "Budi odvažan". Epizoda završava blic-pitanjima, a gost brak definira kao savez dvoje dobronamjernih ljudi koji žele drugoga staviti ispred sebe.
key_points: U brak treba ulagati stalno, a ne tek u krizi: kao što se automobil redovito održava da bi dugo služio, tako i brak zahtijeva redovitu brigu, a dan vjenčanja samo je početak.

Većina bračnih problema nije toliko velika koliko je posljedica nedostatka vještina rješavanja sukoba i zdrave komunikacije, a te se vještine mogu naučiti, primjerice slušanjem da bi se razumjelo, izjavama koje počinju s "ja" i pitanjima "kako to" umjesto "zašto".

Gost preporučuje ozbiljan i dulji zaručnički tečaj. Tečaj koji provodi Fokus ima sedam susreta tijekom dva do tri mjeseca, a parovima se savjetuje da se suzdrže od fizičkog jer ono zamagljuje stvarnu komunikaciju.
Prema istraživanju koje gost navodi, žene kao glavni razlog manjka želje za intimnošću navode nedostatak muške inicijative, pod čime misle na pažnju tijekom cijelog dana, a ne samo u spavaćoj sobi.

Ovisnost o pornografiji obično počinje davno prije braka i ne nestaje ulaskom u brak. Potrebno ju je ozbiljno shvatiti, prepoznati okidače i ponekad poduzeti radikalne korake, poput odricanja od interneta kod kuće ili promjene broja telefona.
U financijama nije presudno koliko novca par ima, nego kako ga troši. Ozbiljniji problem od samog novca je narušeno povjerenje, primjerice zbog skrivanja ili manipulacije novcem.

Knjiga "Naše nedovršene priče" donosi svjedočanstva parova koje su pisala oba supružnika, a samo pisanje mnogima je bilo poput terapije. Program "Budi odvažan" muškarcima pomaže u pitanjima identiteta, ovisnosti, odgovornosti i mentorstva, uz naglasak na ustrajnosti.
key_points_en: One should invest in marriage constantly, not just in crisis: just as a car is regularly maintained so that it serves for a long time, so marriage requires regular care, and the wedding day is only the beginning.

Most marital problems are not so great as they are the consequence of a lack of conflict resolution skills and healthy communication, and these skills can be learned, for example by listening to understand, statements beginning with "I", and asking "how come" instead of "why".

The guest recommends a serious and longer marriage preparation course. The course conducted by Fokus has seven meetings over two to three months, and couples are advised to abstain from the physical because it clouds real communication.

According to research cited by the guest, women cite a lack of male initiative as the main reason for a lack of desire for intimacy, by which they mean attention throughout the entire day, not just in the bedroom.

Pornography addiction usually begins long before marriage and does not disappear upon entering marriage. It must be taken seriously, triggers must be recognized, and sometimes radical steps must be taken, such as giving up the internet at home or changing a phone number.
In finances, what is decisive is not how much money a couple has, but how they spend it. A more serious problem than money itself is broken trust, for instance due to hiding or manipulating money.

The book "Naše nedovršene priče" brings testimonies of couples written by both spouses, and the writing itself was like therapy for many. The program "Budi odvažan" helps men with questions of identity, addiction, responsibility, and mentorship, with an emphasis on perseverance.
summary.title_en: [re:DEFINICIJA] Daniel Wurzberg: Investing in Marriage Happens Every Day (ep. 1)
summary.abstract_en: In the first episode of the Redefinicija podcast by the Muževni budite portal, host Kruno talks with Daniel Wurzberg, a father of four and a long-time worker of the Udruga Fokus, who works with married and engaged couples alongside his wife Kate. The conversation covers the stigma surrounding marriage counseling, the importance of premarital preparation, communication as the most common cause of conflict, sexuality in marriage, pornography, and finances. The guest emphasizes that marriage needs to be nurtured daily, like car maintenance, and that most problems are actually a lack of communication and conflict resolution skills, which can be learned. He also presents the book "Naše nedovršene priče" and the men's program "Budi odvažan". The episode ends with quick-fire questions, and the guest defines marriage as a covenant between two well-intentioned people who want to put the other ahead of themselves.
